_comment: The Cave Registry Data Archive's CheddarCatchment dataset, built by cave-viewer (python -m caveviewer build caves.json --out site/). Each cave's survey: its folder here, its main Therion file, Survex files Therion imports (built first with cavern), and the selects for its plan. defaults: what every cave shares. The catchment page draws all of CheddarCatchment.th together. See cave-viewer's caveviewer/schema.json for every key.

site.title: The Cheddar Catchment in 3D
site.description: Caves of the Cheddar catchment, Mendip, in 3D beneath the ground: the whole catchment together, and the larger caves each with its drawn survey.
site.lede: The Cave Registry Data Archive's CheddarCatchment dataset in 3D beneath the LiDAR ground and satellite imagery: the whole catchment together, every entrance named, and the larger caves each with routes and its drawn survey as a 2D plan.
site.footer: Survey data: the Cave Registry Data Archive's CheddarCatchment dataset, maintained by UBSS and MCG with many other clubs and individuals. Each cave's data has its own licence, as its files state: {credits}. Ground: Environment Agency LiDAR Composite DTM, OGL v3. Imagery: Esri.

grid._comment: Therion's export is on the ST 100 km square of the National Grid

walls._comment: passage walls in 3D, built by Therion from the drawings

caves.name: The Cheddar Catchment
caves.credit: Every survey in the Cave Registry Data Archive's CheddarCatchment dataset, by UBSS, MCG, the Charterhouse Digging Team, the Cave Diving Group and many other clubs and cavers. Each cave's data has its own terms: see LICENCES.md
caves._comment: Everything in CheddarCatchment.th at once, entrances named (catchment-names.json, from tools/entrances.py): even a cave that's only an entrance or a few legs is here.
